notes:
Withdrawing old invitations is fixed. On some accounts the confirmation dialog
opened but the confirm button inside it was never found, so nothing was ever
withdrawn. This mainly affected accounts that always have another LinkedIn
panel open, for example the messaging overview.

Scanning the invitation list also stopped too early whenever LinkedIn stalled
while loading more entries. Only the newest invitations were loaded then, and
none of them were old enough. It now keeps going until the daily quota is
covered or the list has really ended.

If the confirm button is ever missing again, the app now writes the details it
needs straight into the log so the case can be sorted out quickly.
